notes: The application channel is de-university-direct: the pages state that international applicants apply directly via the DIT online application portal, Primuss; no uni-assist or VPD is mentioned. The tuition fee of EUR 500 per semester is stated on the DAAD page as applying to applicants from non-EU countries. The 'No tuition fees' statement on the th-deg.de/eai-b-en page appears in the general 'Fees' section and is not quoted for the tuition fact because it conflicts with the DAAD non-EU fee. Dates for the application period (15 October – 1 December) are given without a year.
